text: You do not have to be good. You only have to keep going.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
author: Japanese proverb

text: The urge is temporary. The regret of acting on it lasts longer than the urge would have.
Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space is our power to choose.
author: Viktor Frankl

text: A slip is a comma, not a full stop.
You are not the voice in your head that says you can't. You are the one who notices it.
Discipline is choosing between what you want now and what you want most.
The wave will pass whether you ride it or fight it. Riding it costs less.
What you practise grows stronger. Choose the practice.
Courage is not the absence of the urge, but showing up despite it.
Every day you show up is a vote for the person you're becoming.
Be patient with yourself. Nothing in nature blooms all year.
The comeback is always stronger than the setback.
You don't have to see the whole staircase. Just take the first step.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.

text: Recovery is not one big decision. It's a thousand small ones, and you can make the next one now.
Shame says 'I am bad'. Recovery says 'I did something I want to change'. The second one is workable.
The best time to start over is the next moment. It's always available.
